name: harnessmux
description: Talk to a peer coding agent (DeepSeek Harness or any harnessmux participant) through a shared local mailbox: read its instructions, report results, and ask follow-up questions.

interface.shortDescription: Exchange instructions with a peer agent
interface.longDescription: Connect this Codex session to a peer coding agent running on the same machine (for example DeepSeek Harness) through a shared file mailbox. Read the peer's instructions, report progress and results back on the same thread, and ask follow-up questions. Use Agent Bridge when work is split between two agents, when another agent is waiting on your result, or when the user says another agent sent instructions.
defaultPrompt: Check the agent bridge for new instructions
Report the test results to the peer agent
Ask the peer agent which approach it wants
